name: Wrapping — Tuck a Toy into Bed
summary: Drape a blanket over the toy or wrap it in a pillowcase, then grind or ride it so your body moves rather than the vibrator—giving full-body reverberations.
detailed_description: Instead of moving the toy against you, anchor it under bedding and move your body over it. Drape a blanket or tuck the vibrator into a pillowcase, then grind or ride against it. The fabric softens the buzz and the grinding motion spreads sensation into full-body reverberations.
stepwise_structure: 1. Place the vibrator on the bed and drape a blanket over it or slip it into a pillowcase.
2. Position yourself over the covered toy.
3. Grind or ride against it—let your body provide the movement.
4. Shift weight and angle to direct the vibration and build full-body reverberations.
safety_notes: Make sure the toy stays stable so it doesn't slip awkwardly.
Use a fabric layer thick enough to keep intensity comfortable.
